scope.coverage: Generated module-plan and program-model evidence contains one function, one global, and one type (three indexed entities). With maximumIndexedEntities=3, the active ACP repair admits a replacement, records completed final-snapshot and verified cleanup evidence, and reaches an injected validator that verifies candidate bytes and profile/index/source-revision bindings before throwing its expected sentinel. With maximumIndexedEntities=2, active admission returns the exact typed resource-limit diagnostic before ACP dispatch and candidate validation; original source and plan/model evidence remain unchanged, no run or pending attempt is retained, and a subsequent graph open succeeds with no run or pending attempt.
